data.narrative:
Liminal Insights is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Barry Van Tassell and Shaurjo Biswas that has raised $38.9M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of nine private peers in the Climate & Energy sector, including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen, alongside one public comparable (LNZA).

The peer-median method could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with sufficient granularity; a narrow filter yielded fewer than three datapoints, making sector-wide median analysis unreliable. The stage-progression method is therefore the primary applicable approach, applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage advancement to the $39M total raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $78M.

The triangulation range spans $66M (low) to $89M (high), with a median of $78M. This range reflects the single-method analysis and carries meaningful uncertainty around comparable selection and appropriate stage-progression multiples for the climate-tech sector, where company trajectories and funding patterns diverge significantly. Additional primary diligence on unit economics, customer concentration, and technology risk would be needed to narrow the range further.
